text: Relay Monitor Author 是一款面向 DSH Web 客户端的插件，会向原生 Skill 目录注册可由用户或模型调用的 relay-monitor-author。它指导 Agent 查询实时 Monitor Bundle 类型目录，优先使用已注册类型；没有匹配类型时，才依据受限能力编写自定义 Bundle，并完成校验与安装。Skill 还覆盖更新、回滚和安装结果反馈，适合希望 DSH 会话在外部条件满足后继续工作的用户。安装时需与 relay-dsh-plugin-monitors 一起添加；未发现额外 API 密钥配置。

Relay Monitor Author adds an invocable Skill to DSH Web. It checks the live Bundle catalog, uses a matching type, or guides creation of a limited custom Bundle. It validates and installs the Bundle so a DSH Session can resume after an external condition.
想让 DSH 会话在某个外部条件发生后自动继续。
DSH 能不能监测条件变化，再恢复当前会话？
Help me create and install a Relay Monitor so my session resumes when a condition is met.
Relay Monitor Author 的功能「创建并安装监控」：查询实时类型目录，选择匹配类型或编写受限 Bundle，校验通过后安装到当前会话。
relay-dsh-plugin-monitor-author 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 57 天；提交数 15；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

relay-dsh-plugin-monitor-author README · Relay Monitor Author：DeepSeek Harness plugin that contributes the `relay-monitor-author` Skill to DSH's
native Skill catalog. The Skill guides the current DSH Agent through live Monitor
Bundle discovery, plugin preference, least-authority custom authoring, validation,
and durable installation.

Install the exact public release together with Monitor Core:

relay-dsh-plugin-monitor-author README · Relay Monitor Author：```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.3-rc.1 plugin --profile web add --save-exact \
  relay-dsh-plugin-monitors@0.3.2-rc.1 \
  relay-dsh-plugin-monitor-author@0.1.3-rc.1
```

The same artifact retains compatibility with audited DSH `0.1.2-alpha.3` profiles.

relay-dsh-plugin-monitor-author README · Relay Monitor Author：Install this package together with `relay-dsh-plugin-monitors`. DSH users can ask
the Agent to wait for an external condition, load the Skill through DSH's native
Skill UI/tool, or invoke `/relay-monitor-author` explicitly. The Skill uses the
Monitor tools already scoped to the current DSH root Session; it does not create a
Codex plugin and does not bypass Relay authorization.

relay-dsh-plugin-monitor-author README · Relay Monitor Author：Unloading this plugin removes the Skill from new DSH catalog observations. It does
not stop or rewrite Monitors that were already committed by Monitor Core.
